source_quote:
![high]
Calling `self.named_parameters()` on the top-level `AscendKimiK3ForConditionalGeneration` model recursively traverses all parameters of the entire language model and vision tower. For large models, this is extremely inefficient and introduces a significant performance bottleneck during model loading. Since we only need to check if the projector's rotation weights are loaded, we can query `self.mm_projector.rot_proj.named_parameters()` directly if it is not `None`, which is extremely fast and avoids full-model parameter traversal.

rule.description: 在 `load_weights` 或其他加载期逻辑中，若只需检查某个子模块（如 `mm_projector.rot_proj`）的参数是否被加载，禁止用 `self.named_parameters()`（顶层模型）递归遍历整个模型（LM + vision tower 等所有参数），对大模型会引入显著加载性能瓶颈。必须直接调用目标子模块的 `named_parameters(prefix=...)`，只遍历该子模块的参数。用 `prefix` 参数保证参数名与 `loaded_weights` 的全限定名命名空间一致，便于集合比对。
checkpoints: 识别 `load_weights` 或加载期逻辑中调用 `self.named_parameters()` / `model.named_parameters()` 的代码
确认遍历目的是否只关心某个子模块的参数——若是，改为 `submodule.named_parameters(prefix="full.qualified.path")`
用 `prefix` 参数限定命名空间，保证返回的参数名与 `loaded_weights` / checkpoint 的全限定名一致
用集合操作（`isdisjoint` / `intersection`）比对参数名，避免 O(n*m) 嵌套遍历
配套单测覆盖"权重存在 → 保留子模块"和"权重不存在 → 删除子模块"两种情况

antipattern.code:
# vllm_ascend/models/kimi_k3.py
# AscendKimiK3ForConditionalGeneration.load_weights 方法，约第 600-620 行
class AscendKimiK3ForConditionalGeneration:
    # ...

    def load_weights(self, weights: Iterable[tuple[str, torch.Tensor]]) -> set[str]:
        # ❌ 用 self.named_parameters() 遍历整个模型（LM + vision tower）
        # ❌ 只为检查 projector rotation 权重是否被加载，对大模型极低效
        skip_prefixes = [] if self.mm_projector.rot_proj is not None else ["mm_projector.rot_proj."]
        loader = AutoWeightsLoader(self, skip_prefixes=skip_prefixes)
        loaded_weights = loader.load_weights(weights, mapper=self.hf_to_vllm_mapper)

        # ❌ 全模型遍历：O(n) 其中 n 是 LM + vision tower 全部参数量
        all_param_names = {name for name, _ in self.named_parameters()}
        rot_proj_loaded = any(
            name.startswith("mm_projector.rot_proj") for name in all_param_names
        )
        # ❌ 大模型下遍历数亿参数，加载期显著性能瓶颈

        return loaded_weights

pattern.code:
# vllm_ascend/models/kimi_k3.py
class AscendKimiK3ForConditionalGeneration:
    # ...

    def load_weights(self, weights: Iterable[tuple[str, torch.Tensor]]) -> set[str]:
        # ModelSlim checkpoints may include an explicit projector rotation.
        # Build the optional layer before loading so streaming checkpoint
        # iterators can populate it, then release it when the weight is absent.
        rot_proj = getattr(self.mm_projector, "rot_proj", None)
        skip_prefixes = [] if rot_proj is not None else ["mm_projector.rot_proj."]
        loader = AutoWeightsLoader(self, skip_prefixes=skip_prefixes)
        # ✅ 只查询 rot_proj 子模块的参数，用 prefix 限定命名空间
        # ✅ O(k) 其中 k 是 rot_proj 参数数（通常 < 10），极快
        rot_proj_weight_names = (
            {name for name, _ in rot_proj.named_parameters(prefix="mm_projector.rot_proj")}
            if rot_proj is not None
            else set()
        )
        loaded_weights = loader.load_weights(weights, mapper=self.hf_to_vllm_mapper)
        # ✅ 检查 rot_proj 权重是否被加载，未加载则删除该层
        if rot_proj is not None and rot_proj_weight_names.isdisjoint(loaded_weights):
            del self.mm_projector.rot_proj
        return loaded_weights
